biggest_catch: Offers run lower than top competitors for many brands (a reported $20 Target card fetched $13.86 — about 69%) and physical cards must be mailed before payment.
catches: Reported offers vary widely by brand; the documented $20 Target -> $13.86 example is ~69% of face value.
Only check or PayPal payouts — no ACH/direct deposit; checks take 5-14 days by mail, PayPal up to 3 days.
Physical cards must be mailed in before payment; processing adds days.
Accepted brand list is narrow (reported list includes several defunct brands — confirm current list before relying on it).
Rewards points only redeem against ClipKard discounted-card purchases, not cash.

eligibility: US sellers; supported retailer/restaurant brands (narrower list than CardCash — verify your brand is accepted before starting)
maximize: Get ClipKard's written offer first, then run the same brand through Gift Card Granny's comparison and CardCash's instant quote — sell wherever pays most, because reported ClipKard offers can lag competitors. Use the free USPS first-class shipping their FAQ promises instead of paying for priority. Bank the reward points (1 per dollar; 1,000 = $10 off a future discounted-card buy) and stack them with a discounted card purchase for planned spending — that's the angle ClipKard uniquely offers.

s6.note: 5 steps: add card, get offer, mail card, receive payment, earn rewards.

steps: Add your gift card details on clipkard.com
Get an instant offer estimate for your card
Accept the offer and mail in the physical card (free USPS first-class shipping provided)
Receive payment by check (5-14 days) or PayPal (up to 3 days)
Earn 1 reward point per dollar; 1,000 points = $10 off a future purchase
timing: Paid after card is received and verified: PayPal up to 3 days, mailed check 5-14 days
who_pays: ClipKard pays you directly — it buys your card outright.
who_qualifies: US sellers with cards from ClipKard's supported retailer/restaurant brands — check your brand is accepted before starting, as the list is narrower than the big exchanges.
work_available: ClipKard's buy service is operating under official payout terms, though its accepted-brand list appears narrower than major competitors.
what_gets_accepted: Your card must be from a supported brand with a verifiable balance; physical cards must be mailed in and received before any payment.
costs_and_unpaid_time: Officially no selling fees; the only seller cost is optional priority shipping. Unpaid time goes to mailing physical cards and waiting through processing.
when_cash_arrives: After your card is received and verified: PayPal up to 3 days, mailed check 5–14 days. No ACH or direct deposit option.
